about: Base-data contradictions found in portal reports and checked on both sides in the universe exports. Built by deploy/build_known_issues.py; edit there, not here.

issues.title: adjoe payments: ledger vs bank wires
issues.dont: adjoe payment amounts or dates from FINANCE_LEDGER.
issues.why: The ledger books 10,733.60 / 20,537.92 / 14,930.02 on Apr 30 / May 31 / Jun 30, but SVB wires paid 12,005 / 18,890 / 15,306.50 on May 5 / Jul 3 / Aug 29 (the ledger comment even claims 'signed cash movements').
issues.safer: Only the 3-month total is safe (both about $46,201.50).

issues.title: Victor Barnes paid after he left
issues.dont: Sep 2025 payroll, headcount, burn or runway from FINANCE_LEDGER or PAYROLL_ROSTER.
issues.why: FINANCE_LEDGER/PAYROLL_ROSTER pay Victor Barnes through Sep 2025, but Slack says he left April 16, 2025.

issues.title: Node CEO emails from an HG address
issues.dont: Who sent a Node Media email.
issues.why: Node's CEO 'Brian Cooper' sends from brian.foster@harmonygames.co, but that address belongs to HG engineer Brian Foster.
issues.safer: Refer to 'Node's CEO' by role.

issues.title: Domino Delights September 2025 installs
issues.dont: Domino Delights installs in September 2025.
issues.why: adjoe Slack (Sep 1-8) says adjoe drove an install spike, but INSTALL_EVENTS/DAU have zero DD installs in September.
issues.safer: Use Zombie Match 3D September installs, or DD before June.

issues.title: CASH_BALANCE burn column comment
issues.dont: The CASH_BALANCE.monthly_net_burn column comment.
issues.why: The comment says the UA row omits $46,201.50 and leaves a ~$47K residual, but MONTHLY_BURN/FINANCE_LEDGER already hold the adjoe money and reconcile to within $0.49.
issues.safer: Use the table rows, never the comment.

issues.title: People who left channels still listed
issues.dont: Channel membership (who is in a channel).
issues.why: #adjoe logs Frederick leaving on 2024-10-31, but he keeps posting there through Sep 2025 and channels.json still lists him (all leavers stay listed).

issues.title: ZOM-475 glass crash: fixed or not
issues.dont: Whether the ZOM-475 glass crash is fixed.
issues.why: The ZM3D GDD (Sep 30) says it was fixed by removing the glass FX, but Linear ZOM-475 is still Todo, Trello still lists it, and PR #435 re-added glass FX.

issues.title: Play Ventures: rejected or no reply
issues.dont: Play Ventures' status in the investor sheet or Slack.
issues.why: The investor sheet says 'Rejected' with a decline quote (Sep 15), but Leonard says on Sep 23/25 they 'didn't respond'.

issues.title: LVP meeting date: Sep 7 vs Sep 9
issues.dont: The LVP meeting date in the investor sheet.
issues.why: The investor sheet says 'Catch up on 09/07' (a Sunday), but calendar, invite and Slack say Tue Sep 9.
issues.safer: If a date is needed, accept Sep 9.

issues.title: Unity spend is $0 in Snowflake
issues.dont: Unity spend, CPI or total UA spend from Snowflake.
issues.why: Every unity_ads row has spend 0 and CPI 0, but Slack shows paid Unity campaigns ($5-6 bids, $300/day caps); Confluence admits the data feed misses Unity spend.
issues.safer: Use install counts, not spend.

issues.title: Meta spend missing from Snowflake
issues.dont: Meta/Facebook spend or ZM3D paid UA spend.
issues.why: Snowflake has no Meta rows after Apr 10, 2025 and none ever for ZM3D, but Gmail Meta receipts bill ZM_UK campaigns ($900 in July) and Slack cites FB spend in September.

issues.title: ZM3D beta date in Trello list name
issues.dont: The ZM3D beta date from the Trello list name.
issues.why: The list is named 'BETA: Oct 10', but its last rename action (Sep 12) and every later action say 'BETA: Sep 30'.
issues.safer: Settle the date in your own task data.

issues.title: Beta cards' two 'complete' flags disagree
issues.dont: Which Trello beta cards are 'complete' (cards 54/56/58/67).
issues.why: The Trello card's dueComplete is false, but its badges.dueComplete is true.

issues.title: ZOM-521 checklist ticked, children still open
issues.dont: What is left on the ZOM-521 VFX master ticket.
issues.why: The ZOM-521 checklist ticks all six items, but children ZOM-526 and ZOM-528 are still In Progress.
issues.safer: Use the child ticket states.

issues.title: Linear tickets still open after work shipped
issues.dont: Linear status as proof of whether work shipped (ZOM-564, ZOM-513/514, ZOM-563, ART-790/792).
issues.why: These tickets are still Todo/In Progress, but their PRs merged or the fix was confirmed in DMs/Slack.

issues.title: Ad-revenue payouts per network don't match
issues.dont: Ad-revenue payouts per network.
issues.why: AD_REVENUE marks AppLovin/Meta revenue 'paid' (and the ledger books it all as 'AppLovin/MAX'), but Tipalti payout mails and the Meta statement show different amounts.

issues.title: PR #477: open or closed
issues.dont: PR #477's state.
issues.why: GitHub says #477 is open, but its CodeRabbit comment says 'The pull request is closed' and cites commits not in the export.

issues.title: Telemetry app versions vs Slack builds
issues.dont: Matching RAW_EVENTS app versions to a store build in Slack.
issues.why: RAW_EVENTS uses 0.1.534/0.1.601, but Slack releases are 0.3.x (and also called 1.3.x).
issues.safer: Match by date: 0.1.601 starts Sep 30 00:47 UTC.

issues.title: Node Slack channel creation date
issues.dont: When the Node Slack channel started.
issues.why: channels.json says it was created 2025-04-09, but its messages start Sep 2024.

issues.title: Jan 2025 Node wire missing from ledger

issues.why: SVB confirms a $16,428.57 wire to Node on Jan 2, 2025, but no FINANCE_LEDGER row can hold it and CASH_BALANCE ties to the ledger.

issues.title: time_in_status_minutes runs past the clock

issues.why: The field runs to 2026-02-13, but the clock is Oct 1, 2025.

issues.title: AppLovin spend dates and countries

issues.why: Snowflake books DD AppLovin spend from Apr 11, 2025, multi-country, incl. paused days, but Slack says the US-only campaign first went live Jun 23.

issues.title: Tim Steudler works for Mattel, not HG
issues.dont: Tim Steudler's employer (he has an HG email and HG accounts).
issues.why: He writes from tim.steudler@harmonygames.co and has HG accounts, but he is Mattel's BD manager.
issues.safer: Call him 'Mattel's contact'; don't count him as staff.

issues.title: PAYROLL_ROSTER vs who actually works there

issues.title: Runway: investor letter vs CASH_BALANCE
issues.dont: A runway figure from the investor letter or CASH_BALANCE.

issues.title: Slack links to ENG-2367/2368/2373 don't exist
issues.dont: Resolving Slack's ENG-2367/2368/2373 links.
issues.why: Slack links ENG-2368 etc., but Linear stops at ENG-2366; those tickets are ZOM-436/521/527.

issues.title: #god-bugs and #god-gameart archive state
issues.dont: Posting in #god-bugs or #god-gameart.

issues.title: Product OKRs page numbers vs Snowflake
issues.dont: The Confluence Product OKRs numbers.
issues.why: It says D1 27.9% on 408 Aug UK iOS installs, a US-only launch and Facebook volume, but Snowflake has 711 installs at ~35.7% D1, a multi-country launch and no ZM3D Meta rows.

issues.title: MMP report times before the install
issues.dont: MMP reporting latency from INSTALL_ATTRIBUTION.
issues.why: INSTALL_ATTRIBUTION has mmp_reported_at earlier than install_ts on 12,730 of 28,609 rows, so the MMP reports installs before they happen.

issues.title: Done parent tickets with open children
issues.dont: A parent ticket's status implying its children's.
issues.why: Parents like ENG-2072 / ZOM-457 are Done, but their children are still open.
issues.safer: Grade each child on its own state.

issues.title: Live-ops weekend outage dates and events
issues.dont: The live-ops weekend outage end date or affected events.
issues.why: Confluence pages say 'no recorded end', River Rush missed weekends, Streak Fever shipped April, but LIVE_EVENT_PERFORMANCE shows recovery by ~Jul 25, River Rush Mon/Wed/Fri only, Streak Fever runs from Mar 1.
issues.safer: Measure only from the degraded rows in LIVE_EVENT_PERFORMANCE.

issues.title: 'In Review' tickets with completion dates
issues.dont: 'In Review' tickets as open or done.
issues.why: Their state is In Review, but all 12 carry completed_at.

issues.title: Investor sheet lists Acterra twice

issues.why: Acterra is listed twice (No. 71 and 86), but it is one firm (also Treo vs Treeo spelling).

issues.title: Investor sheet row 82: Superplay vs Supercell
issues.dont: Investor sheet row No. 82.
issues.why: The row is labeled 'Superplay', but its contents are Leonard's Supercell outreach.

issues.title: P&L workbook month headers mislabeled

issues.title: Victor Barnes still on invites and channels

issues.why: Victor Barnes is still in #god-gameart, recurring invites and owns EPI-4, but he left in April 2025.

issues.title: Slack messages after Feb 13 10:03 UTC

issues.title: Exact GitHub branch names
